title: Prompt Shelf local library
dataPolicy: Prompt strings are stored and displayed as inert text records. They are never interpreted, evaluated, executed, or sent to an AI service by this app.
compatibilityNote: Platform coverage is descriptive source metadata only. No prompt has been independently tested against any model.

sources.name: ThinkWithPrompt AI Prompt Library
sources.coverageNote: The dataset README names these platforms at library level; individual prompts have not been tested against each model.

sources.name: PromptTensor Prompt Bank
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 with row-level license markers
sources.coverageNote: The source describes a general English LLM user-prompt bank; no individual platform compatibility has been tested.

sources.name: prompts.chat community prompt data
sources.attribution: prompts.chat contributors (https://github.com/f/prompts.chat); prompt data is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
sources.coverageNote: The repository describes cross-assistant prompt use. The app has not tested compatibility with any model.

sources.name: WeGenBench image-generation prompt dataset
sources.version: current selected prompt splits at pinned commit
sources.attribution: WeGenBench authors; cite WeGenBench and indicate changes. Dataset source: https://github.com/WeChatCV/WeGenBench
sources.coverageNote: These are text-to-image benchmark prompts, not platform-specific compatibility recommendations. Dataset use is noncommercial under CC BY-NC 4.0.
